# Model fixtures

Documents aimed at how formatting is stored rather than how it lays out: theme references, explicit off and automatic
values, toggle inheritance, markup the reader does not model, namespace prefixes, and content copied between
documents. Their layout, render and PDF snapshots were written by the engine before the typed model existed, so they
pin today's behaviour on exactly the cases a typed model has to get right.

`make-model-fixtures.py` writes every file here: `python -I crates/twip/tests/fixtures/model/make-model-fixtures.py`.
Standard library only, the same bytes on every run. Every package validates against the OOXML schemas
(`tests/fidelity/validate`) except `unknown-attributes`, whose `w:jc w:val="sideways"` is deliberately invalid.
Highlight is not set in a style anywhere: the schema check rejects `w:highlight` in a style's run properties, so
`explicit-off` shows unset, set and `none` highlight directly.

| Fixture | Content | What it proves |
|---|---|---|
| `theme-references` | Theme colours with tints and shades on text (`w:color`), underlines (`w:u`), run and paragraph shading (`w:shd` themeFill/themeColor with themeFillTint/themeFillShade), run borders (`w:bdr`), paragraph borders (`w:pBdr`) and cell borders (`w:tcBorders`). A table style (`ThemeGrid`) with theme borders, a firstRow fill and band1Horz fill/border. Theme fonts in all four slots (asciiTheme, hAnsiTheme, eastAsiaTheme, cstheme), set directly, in a paragraph style and in a character style. An empty major East Asian slot over an explicit `w:eastAsia` on the same `w:rFonts` and from a paragraph style. A page background in a tinted theme colour with `w:displayBackgroundShape` | Theme references survive as references alongside their RGB, the resolved colours and fonts match the stored values, and saving does not replace a reference with its RGB |
| `explicit-off` | Explicit off, none and automatic values over styles that turn them on: b val="0" and val="false" over a bold paragraph style and a bold character style, u none, color auto, run and paragraph shd nil and shd clear with fill auto, numId 0 over a list paragraph style (with a numbering part), a style tab cleared with tab val="clear", ind left 0 and firstLine 0 over an indented style, vanish val="0" over a hidden character style, keepNext val="0" over a keep-with-next style, and highlight none next to direct highlight. Each case sits next to a control in the same style with nothing direct | Unset, off and automatic stay three separate states through parse, edit, serialize and resolve |
| `style-toggles` | Bold (`w:b`) in docDefaults under everything; bold paragraph and character styles each alone and together; a three-level character `basedOn` chain (bold, italic, bold); a table style whose `firstRow` region is bold (tblLook firstRow on) over Normal, bold-character-style and bold-paragraph-style cell paragraphs; a linked paragraph/character style pair; a list level with a bold label `rPr`; `bCs`/`iCs` in paragraph and character styles and direct on `w:cs` and `w:rtl` runs; direct `w:b`/`w:b w:val="0"`/`bCs`/`iCs` over each | Toggle properties XOR across levels (defaults, table region, paragraph style, character style) and are absolute within one style chain, in direct formatting and in a list label's level properties; the complex-script path reads only `bCs`/`iCs` |
| `unknown-attributes` | Unread attributes on read elements (`w:lang w:bidi`; `tx:` extension attributes on `w:color`, `w:spacing` and `w:jc`, with `tx` in `mc:Ignorable`); unread children in rPr (`w:webHidden`, `w:effect`, `w14:props3d`), pPr (`w:adjustRightInd`, `w:cnfStyle`), tblPr (`w:tblCaption`, `w:tblDescription`), tcPr (`w:cnfStyle`), sectPr (`w:paperSrc`, `w:bidi`) and sdtPr (`w15:webExtensionLinked`, `w15:webExtensionCreated`); ignorable `tx:` elements in rPr and between runs; a paragraph-level `mc:AlternateContent` whose Choice requires an unknown namespace; a bold run holding all of these beside read properties; and `w:jc w:val="sideways"` (the only schema error) | The unmodelled-props remainder holds both children and attributes, they survive an edit to a neighbouring property, and an invalid enumeration literal reads as a fallback (left) |
| `namespace-dependencies` | Main document under `x:` (root declares only `x`) with one paragraph in the default namespace, one with `w:` bound on the paragraph, `w14` ligatures and text outline bound on a paragraph, a `w14:checkbox` control bound on the `x:sdt`, and `r` bound on `x:sectPr`; a header under `w:` whose root has no `w14`/`w15`, with `w14` bound on a run and `w15:collapsed` bound on a paragraph; a footer entirely in the default namespace; styles with every prefix on the root | Serialization uses the destination part's prefixes, foreign nodes carry the bindings declared on their ancestors, and nothing is written with an undeclared prefix |
| `foreign-content-copy-source`, `foreign-content-copy-destination` | Source: an inline Office Math fraction, an editable range (`w:permStart` edGrp="everyone") under enforced read-only protection, a run with `w14:scene3d` and `w14:props3d`, a plain-text content control with alias, tag, id and the unmodelled `w15:color`, `w15:appearance` and `w15:webExtensionLinked`, an inline picture related to a PNG media part, and the Source Quote and Source Mark styles. Destination: the main namespace bound to `x` in the body and as the default namespace in its header, with m, w14, mc and the drawing namespaces not declared, and only its own Destination styles | Copying within a part, into a header and across documents: markup is kept verbatim where it is allowed, namespaces are declared again, nodes tied to the package are dropped with a diagnostic, and anchors are detached |
